answer: A garden of per-task receipts records who did what, and the nadir of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on time-locked work history, re-queued for a second panel, idle agents bleed standing. What survives to the gale is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
